name: io.github.xhighhongo41/patent-checker
description: Prior-art exploration for software projects; finds related patents, never judges infringement

packageArguments.name: --transport
packageArguments.description: Speak MCP over stdio (runs with the invoking user's permissions)

environmentVariables.description: EPO OPS credentials; leave unset for degraded mode
